items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 11 at 7:18AM EDT until October 11 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level
along shorelines and tidal waterways (7.1 to 7.3 feet Mean
Lower Low Water at Charleston).

* WHERE...Coastal Colleton County.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM EDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...This could result in some roads becoming impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tide will occur around 9:15 AM this
morning at Charleston. Saltwater inundation will be possible 1
to 2 hours before and after high tide.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Visit water.weather.gov for additional water level and flood
impact information.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 11 at 7:16AM EDT until October 11 at 11:00PM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and
seas 3 to 6 ft.

* WHERE...Edisto Beach to Savannah out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
